description: Seed cards for existing Notion Dev Requirements pipeline; FC IDs MUST be replaced with actual REQ IDs

cards.title: Founder Console source-of-truth audit and route decision
cards.goal: Record the exact existing auth, CRM, scheduling, trial, follow-up, payment, media-task and event contracts needed by the console, with a decisive app placement plan.
scope: Read current root/per-app CLAUDE.md, ADRs, open req PRs and all relevant implementations
Identify source systems, stable identifiers, data freshness and existing permissions
Choose same-origin path/app strategy, surface design decisions, and record missing evidence
Do not change app code or live data; deliver a concise ADR/spec or equivalent allowed docs change
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Decision record gives a current file path, function/API and authority for each of the 8 core data domains, or marks as undiscovered with reproducible evidence.
AC2: Proposed console route reuses the current one-domain auth/session pattern and identifies how unauthorized staff are rejected server-side.
AC3: Existing overlap with planned/in-progress REQ cards is reconciled and mapped, not duplicated.
AC4: Freshness, missing-source and external side-effect risks are documented and mapped to downstream cards.
AC5: A source-backed strategy exists for verified recurring-hour computation or a defined "unverifiable" fallback.
test_plan: T1: Reviewer inspects source-path citations for AC1/AC2 and can reproduce at least one data-flow trace.
T2: Docs scope test verifies no app/DB/schema changes were made for this card.
T3: Independent reviewer checks every downstream assumption against documented unknowns.
non_goals: No new product UI, schema, permissions or external integrations.

cards.title: Founder-only same-origin console route and secure app boundary
cards.goal: A founder may reach a protected console shell at the chosen path, while everyone else is denied at both render and API access layers.
scope: Implement route per approved architecture; reuse central auth callback and existing sessions
Use server/data access checks against actual founder permission model
Render loading/access denied and expiry states, with no student PII leakage
Reuse present deployment/proxy patterns, avoiding a second auth pool or login
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Founder navigation loads the chosen same-origin console route without an independent sign-in flow.
AC2: Unauthenticated access redirects to central login with safe return path.
AC3: teacher, student, parent and revoked account cannot retrieve console PII or call console private endpoints.
AC4: Cookie/session behavior and cross-app navigation remain intact.
AC5: Test fixtures prove no sensitive data is rendered during failed permission checks.
test_plan: T1: HTTP and browser tests for founder, guest, teacher, parent, student, revoked account.
T2: Direct API/data-path permission tests independent of hidden UI links.
T3: SSO regression + build/typecheck/tests indicated by changed paths.
non_goals: No new signup or third-party identity service; no broad role permission changes.

cards.title: Truthful console read models and verified weekly-hours metric
cards.goal: Panel queries return minimal authorized, provenance-rich data and never display fabricated metrics.
scope: Implement typed server-side read adapters against discovered canonical sources
Add per-panel status ready/empty/loading/stale/error/unverifiable, timestamps and safe retries
Compute verified net-new recurring teacher-hours by adopted business evidence; when unavailable report unverified with links
Deduplicate stable IDs, preserve time-zone boundaries and avoid expensive full-table copies
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Real read models exist for leads/follow-ups, trial events, teacher hours, content work, payment status and north-star KPI when supported by current sources.
AC2: All panels expose source ID and freshness, with unauthorized fields withheld.
AC3: Net-new weekly hours excludes trials, unpaid/unverified enrollments, duplicate occurrences, one-offs, and reductions are subtracted.
AC4: Incomplete source evidence yields an explicit "unverifiable" state; never fake zero or approximate paid hours.
AC5: Partial provider failure does not replace other successful panel data with zeros.
AC6: Identifiers and joins are stable-record based, not name matching.
test_plan: T1: Unit tests of 7-day time windows including Toronto DST; positive/reduction/empty/unknown edge cases.
T2: Integration tests of source adapter fixtures and partial provider failure.
T3: Data minimization/security tests plus mutation-free read behavior.
T4: Reviewer verifies counted evidence links and actual implementation file paths.
non_goals: No additional CRM DB or new analytic warehouse without separate design.

cards.title: Cinematic command-bridge shell and scalable instrument kit
cards.goal: Create a beautiful responsive console shell matching the approved concept, with semantic reusable data surfaces and no hardcoded fictional business results.
scope: Implement static illustrated skyline as separate art layer; panel borders, header, focus rail, mode switch
Build common Gauge, Radar, Status, InstrumentPanel, Metric, QueueRow and FailureState components
Implement accessibility, color tokens, responsive 1920/1440/1280/390 breakpoints and reduced-motion
Use truthful empty/loading placeholders awaiting FC-03 integration; demo data permitted only in isolated preview/tests
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Screen has identifiable sunset command-bridge identity, header, main panel grid and physical-instrument trim, without baking data into an image.
AC2: Sales, Creation and Operations mode tabs are keyboard navigable and reflect selection.
AC3: All major components have dedicated ready/empty/loading/stale/error variants without fabricated successful data.
AC4: 1440×900/1920×1080 resemble reference in hierarchy, color and density; captured screenshots attached to PR.
AC5: 390×844 and 1280×720 keep primary content reachable without sideways scroll.
AC6: Radar has accessible textual equivalents and honors reduced-motion.
test_plan: T1: Component visual snapshots for modes + status variants.
T2: Playwright/screenshots for desktop/laptop/mobile widths and keyboard traversal.
T3: Automated check for fake hardcoded reference KPIs/names in production sources.
non_goals: No 3D game engine, no decorative buttons presented as working controls.

cards.title: Sales radar and prioritised next-lead Rolodex
cards.goal: Give the founder a real next-best-person-to-call view that retains unresolved leads and explains prioritization.
scope: Implement deduped queue from canonical lead and follow-up data
Deterministic ranking: new → urgent callback → post-trial → due follow-up → older, respecting opt-outs
Show selected lead, last verified touch, trial notes/diagnosis, owner, due time, canonical source links
Filters and keyboard shortcuts; no contact sends in this card
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Queue always points to exactly one highest-ranked eligible item or an honest empty/error state.
AC2: Ranking matches published priority with human-readable reason and stable ordering on ties.
AC3: Resolved, opted-out and cancelled cases do not repeatedly re-enter; duplicate-source records are handled.
AC4: Trial diagnosis displayed when available; missing notes shown as missing and never generated as facts.
AC5: Clicking a link opens the correct canonical record; privacy scope respected.
AC6: Leads remain queued on network failure or incomplete response; errors are visible.
test_plan: T1: Table-driven priority tests incl identical timestamps/opt-outs/deduping.
T2: Integration test with stale provider failure and incomplete pagination.
T3: Browser founder use: filter, next lead, open record, keyboard navigate.
non_goals: No autonomous calls, texts, AI lead scoring or source record edits.

cards.title: Explicit call outcomes, next-action follow-ups and safe queue progression
cards.goal: After a real call, the founder can explicitly record a truthful result and scheduled follow-up in the existing authoritative system, then advance the Rolodex.
scope: Use existing write-through adapter/Notion Work/CRM policy where authorized
Offer safe actions or canonical deep link when no supported write path exists
Validate idempotency/stale state; read after write; leave unresolved items with owner + next date
Separate draft message/call notes from any external sending; no auto-send
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Founder can choose explicit outcome and due date; server verifies permission and existing authoritative transition.
AC2: After verified write the queue updates and does not lose unresolved contacts; failed writes remain visible and retry-safe.
AC3: Duplicate action submits do not create duplicate follow-up cases, or unsupported retries are blocked with verification guidance.
AC4: "Paid" requires payment/enrolment evidence and cannot be set from verbal consent or trial completion alone.
AC5: External message/call is never sent merely by opening or logging the case.
AC6: Mutations produce existing audit/evidence record, with source ID and actual result.
test_plan: T1: Allowed/disallowed transition matrix and server auth/CSRF-equivalent checks.
T2: Duplicate submit + timeout-after-commit + read-back recovery tests.
T3: Browser safe test fixture logs call outcome and proves queue advances and reload persists.
non_goals: No bulk outbound communication, payment writes or appointment modifications.

cards.title: Teacher load, trial funnel, verified financial readouts and delivery gaps
cards.goal: Make staffing availability, trial outcomes, lesson-log gaps and payment verification visually inspectable without assuming unverified facts.
scope: Read from existing teacher roster, adopted schedules/availability and completed lesson logs
Show confirmed hours versus availability, no denominator guess, and links to actual conflicts
Compute trials booked/completed and verified enrolments separately
Finance panel shows CAD collected vs sent/outstanding only where evidence supports; no billing mutation
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Teacher load excludes cancelled occurrences and distinguishes scheduled from delivered lessons.
AC2: Missing teacher availability yields unknown utilization, not 0%/100%.
AC3: Trial attendance is verified by its actual completion evidence, never clock-time elapsed.
AC4: Lesson gaps show stable occurrence links, owner, next action and actual source timestamp.
AC5: Invoice sent/open/paid/refunded are distinguished; only verified paid amounts count as cash collected.
AC6: All cards have error/partial freshness states and canonical deep links.
test_plan: T1: Schedule-exception and changed-occurrence aggregation fixtures.
T2: Attendance/lesson-log mismatch fixtures.
T3: Paid/unpaid/refund/currency fixtures.
T4: Desktop/mobile panel browser acceptance and provider outage.
non_goals: No new teacher scheduler, attendance logger, invoicing service or payment processor.

cards.title: Creation mode backed by the existing marketing work system
cards.goal: A clear creation-mode queue surfaces scripts, filming, edits and the weekly media review without making a second CMS.
scope: Read current Work/Content Library tasks with stages and due dates
Prioritise open creative deliverables while honouring urgent-lead interruption
Open canonical task/asset/script via deep link; optional approved one-step status action
Expose missing metadata and stale sources honestly
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Creation mode surfaces next real task, stage, due date, owner, source link and available details.
AC2: Weekly review task appears if it exists or indicates none found, without auto-creating unrelated tasks.
AC3: Task completion reflects canonical record and can only update via approved write action.
AC4: Critical fresh-lead signal can be surfaced but does not silently switch or discard creative work.
AC5: No recording/publishing happens without separate explicit user choice.
test_plan: T1: Open/completed/stale task ordering fixtures.
T2: Browser mode switching and state persistence for a session.
T3: Confirm creation of no shadow records and no unsolicited publishing API invocation.
non_goals: No complex video editor, content scheduling SaaS, publishing robot.

cards.title: Event-backed actionable signals, interruption policy and integration health
cards.goal: Surface newly actionable leads and actual operational exceptions without false always-on surveillance or interruptions during teaching.
scope: Reuse existing events/realtime/polling where reliable, otherwise bounded polling with freshness
Implement text-rich new-lead notification and snooze/quiet behavior while in protected delivery mode
Alerts for stale follow-ups, missing post-trial decision, missing lesson log and provider failures
Deduplicate, persist as appropriate via existing work records, and link source evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC1: A fresh lead arrives at most once per stable source event and remains accessible after snooze.
AC2: Focus mode and protected teaching time do not auto-call, auto-send or auto-book; deferred alerts are recoverable.
AC3: Every alert identifies actual source/check time and next action; stale providers cannot claim "all clear".
AC4: Dismissal means dismissed display, not completed business outcome; unresolved cases persist canonically.
AC5: Inaccessible alert target does not leak personal information across roles.
test_plan: T1: Duplicate/out-of-order/offline event fixtures.
T2: Browser foreground/background, quiet-mode and missed alert recovery flows.
T3: Failed provider check keeps warning, never silent success.
non_goals: No independent notification platform or unauthorized background phone/messaging activity.

cards.title: Visual fidelity, accessible operation and founder release acceptance
cards.goal: Harden the finished bridge, prove it is both beautiful and truthful, and prepare it for a founder-controlled launch.
scope: Compare browser captures with reference aesthetic at prescribed resolutions
Test all paneled states, keyboard, zoom, screen readers, reduced motion and latency
Verify end-to-end sales, media and operations flows with sanitized realistic fixtures
Record final evidence and founder-only release gate, no auto-release
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Screenshots at 1920×1080 and 1440×900 show required visual signature; 1280×720 and 390×844 remain usable.
AC2: All controls and gauges work with keyboard, announce label/status, and honor reduced-motion.
AC3: No demo contact names, financial metrics, fake status or hardcoded illustrative date appear in deployed production.
AC4: Founder-only API access holds under direct route probing; integration failures degrade safely.
AC5: At least one end-to-end safe record loop succeeds and is supported by audit/readback evidence.
AC6: Readiness explicitly states whether deployed, verified and founder-approved, not just PR merged.
test_plan: T1: Screenshot side-by-side review at 4 sizes.
T2: Automated E2E and auth/RLS regression pack.
T3: Manual founder dry-run checklist and release receipt.
non_goals: No auto-launch, no new scope or feature backlog expansion in polish card.
